metadata.title: CIVITA Geometry Library
metadata.description: Shared, versioned definitions of geometry types, parametrizations, and reference coordinate systems used across CIVITA modules.

description: Shared, versioned parametrization of geometry types used across CIVITA. Each geometry type defines parameters and a right-handed local coordinate system; numerical parameter values and context-specific identifiers belong to individual experimental or computational records.

global_conventions.geometry_type_references: Consumers reference geometry_type_id and geometry_type_version; the local geometry record independently stores parameter values and any dataset-specific metadata.
global_conventions.reference_system_convention: The origin and positive local axis directions are defined by the reference figure together with the textual definition. All local axes form a right-handed Cartesian system.
global_conventions.versioning_policy: Draft definitions may be corrected at their existing versions before the first release. Formally released geometry type versions are immutable. Changes affecting the scientific interpretation of released parametrizations, reference systems, or figures require new geometry type versions.
global_conventions.reference_figures_note: Maintain each authoritative figure and its geometry definition together. Published references must identify an immutable repository commit or release and resolve the figure paths at that same revision.
global_conventions.figure_path_base: Figure paths are relative to the root of civita-schema.

reference_system.y_axis: Transverse direction along the prism thickness.
reference_system.z_axis: Vertical direction along the prism depth.

cube.name: cube
cube.description: Cubic specimen defined by one edge length.

reference_system.origin: Corner point indicated in the cube reference figure.
reference_system.y_axis: Direction along the second orthogonal cube edge.
reference_system.z_axis: Direction along the third orthogonal cube edge.

parameters.name: length
parameters.description: Cube edge length along the local x, y, and z directions.

reference_system.origin: Center of the reference circular end face at z = 0, marked O in the reference figure.
reference_system.x_axis: First transverse direction in the circular x-y cross section.
reference_system.y_axis: Second transverse direction in the circular x-y cross section.
reference_system.z_axis: Longitudinal direction along the cylinder axis, from the reference end face at z = 0 toward the opposite end face at z = length.
reference_system.notes: The diameter is measured in the transverse x-y plane.

parameters.name: length
parameters.description: Cylinder length measured along the local z axis.

parameters.name: diameter
parameters.description: Diameter of the circular cross section in the local x-y plane.

notched_prism.name: notched_prism
notched_prism.description: Rectangular prismatic specimen with a notch along the local z axis. The notch has parallel sides and a semicircular tip whose radius is half the opening width.

reference_system.origin: Midspan point on the specimen centerline indicated in the notched-prism reference figure.
reference_system.x_axis: Longitudinal direction along the specimen length.
reference_system.y_axis: Transverse direction along the specimen thickness.
reference_system.z_axis: Vertical direction along the specimen depth.
reference_system.notch_convention: The notch has parallel sides and terminates in a semicircle whose radius is half notch_width. notch_depth is the strictly positive distance along the local z axis from the notched face to the deepest point of the tip, regardless of the sign of the coordinate displacement. When notch_depth equals half notch_width, the straight-sided segment has zero length. notch_offset is the signed x-coordinate of the notch centerline relative to midspan.

parameters.name: length
parameters.description: Dimension along the local x direction.

parameters.name: thickness
parameters.description: Dimension along the local y direction.

parameters.name: depth
parameters.description: Dimension along the local z direction.

parameters.name: notch_offset
parameters.description: Signed x-coordinate of the notch centerline measured from specimen midspan. A value of 0 indicates a centered notch.

parameters.name: notch_depth
parameters.description: Positive scalar distance from the notched face to the deepest point of the semicircular tip along the local z axis, regardless of the sign of the coordinate displacement.

parameters.name: notch_width
parameters.description: Opening width of the notch.

derived_parameters.name: notch_tip_radius
derived_parameters.description: Radius of the semicircular notch termination, equal to half the notch opening width.

dogbone.name: dogbone
dogbone.description: Dogbone specimen with two identical enlarged heads, two identical transition regions, and a reduced central region.

transition_type.description: Specifies whether the transitions between the enlarged heads and the reduced central region are linear or curved. For curved transitions, the precise curvature is not prescribed.

reference_system.origin: Reference point indicated in the dogbone reference figure.
reference_system.x_axis: Width direction in the specimen plane.
reference_system.z_axis: Longitudinal direction along the full specimen length.

parameters.name: length
parameters.description: Overall specimen length along the local z axis.

parameters.name: width
parameters.description: Overall specimen width across the enlarged heads along the local x axis.

parameters.name: dogbone_central_length
parameters.description: Length of the reduced central region along the local z axis.

parameters.name: dogbone_central_width
parameters.description: Width of the reduced central region along the local x axis.

parameters.name: dogbone_head_length
parameters.description: Length of each enlarged head along the local z axis.

parameters.name: dogbone_thickness
parameters.description: Specimen thickness along the local y axis.

derived_parameters.name: dogbone_transition_length
derived_parameters.description: Longitudinal length of each transition region along the local z axis.

derived_parameters.name: dogbone_transition_width
derived_parameters.description: Lateral width reduction on each side from the enlarged head to the reduced central region along the local x axis.

ell_shape.name: ell_shape
ell_shape.description: L-shaped specimen represented by two orthogonal legs.

reference_system.origin: Upper-left exterior corner on the rear face of the specimen, marked O in the ell-shape reference figure.

parameters.name: thickness
parameters.description: Specimen thickness along the local y direction.

parameters.name: ell_length_1
parameters.description: Length of the first leg as defined in the geometry scheme.

parameters.name: ell_depth_1
parameters.description: Depth of the first leg as defined in the geometry scheme.

parameters.name: ell_length_2
parameters.description: Length of the second leg as defined in the geometry scheme.

parameters.name: ell_depth_2
parameters.description: Depth of the second leg as defined in the geometry scheme.

notched_cylinder.name: notched_cylinder
notched_cylinder.description: Cylindrical specimen with a circumferential notch at midheight.

reference_system.origin: Center of the reference circular end face at z = 0, marked O in the reference figure.
reference_system.x_axis: First transverse direction in the circular x-y cross section.
reference_system.y_axis: Second transverse direction in the circular x-y cross section.
reference_system.z_axis: Longitudinal direction along the cylinder axis, from the reference end face at z = 0 toward the opposite end face at z = length.
reference_system.notes: The diameter is measured in the transverse x-y plane. The notch width is measured axially along z, and the notch depth is measured radially in the cross section.
reference_system.notch_convention: The notch extends around the entire circumference and is centered halfway between the two end faces, at z = length / 2 relative to O.

parameters.name: length
parameters.description: Cylinder length measured along the local z axis.

parameters.name: diameter
parameters.description: Diameter of the circular cross section in the local x-y plane.

parameters.name: notch_depth
parameters.description: Radial depth of the circumferential notch measured inward from the outer cylindrical surface.

parameters.name: notch_width
parameters.description: Axial width of the circumferential notch measured along the local z axis.

parameters.name: notch_tip_radius
parameters.description: Radius at the tip of the circumferential notch in an axial section, when reported.

validation_conventions.geometry_type_resolution: Resolve the exact geometry_type_id and geometry_type_version in the common library. Reject a geometry instance if that pair cannot be resolved.
validation_conventions.parameters: Validate the required independent inputs defined in parameters. Submitted values contain independent parameters only. Reject unknown input names unless the geometry definition expressly permits them.
validation_conventions.numeric_parameters: Parameter values must be finite numbers in the declared units.
validation_conventions.positive_dimensions: Dimensions marked exclusiveMinimum: 0 must be strictly positive. Nonnegative radii may equal zero. Offset parameters may be signed.
validation_conventions.geometric_constraints: After validating independent inputs and their bounds, enforce any geometric_constraints defined for the resolved version. Evaluate each left and right expression and compare the results with the specified operator.
validation_conventions.local_identifiers: Experimental and computational geometry record identifiers, publication source identifiers, and submission file formats are intentionally outside the scope of this global library.
validation_conventions.derived_parameters: Compute each derived parameter from the validated independent inputs and check the result against its declared bounds. Derived values are computed separately from the parameters submitted with the instance.
validation_conventions.expression_syntax: Expressions contain only finite decimal literals, names of independent parameters in the same definition, parentheses, and binary arithmetic operators +, -, *, and /. Parentheses group first, then multiplication and division, then addition and subtraction. Operators of equal precedence associate left to right. Reject division by zero and nonfinite results. Geometric constraints use the same expression syntax on each side and allow > (strictly greater than), >= (greater than or equal to), and < (strictly less than).
